observations: Photo 0 shows two car headlight assemblies, one above the other, placed on a tiled floor. Both have clear lenses with circular main bulbs and smaller auxiliary bulbs. The top headlight has a black plastic housing with visible mounting points and wiring harnesses. The bottom headlight has a slightly different lens design with a more pronounced inner reflector.

Photo 1 shows a front grille with a central Toyota emblem, black vertical slats, and a chrome trim on the outer edges. The grille appears to be made of plastic and metal, with mounting brackets on the sides. The background includes a tiled floor and part of a box with text, including 'CHINA' and 'CITIZEN'.

claims.claim: Prado Jeep front grill and tailight in working condition
claims.evidence: The photos show the grill and headlamps, but there is no visual proof of functionality. No video or demonstration of lights working is provided.
Location is stated by seller, but cannot be verified from photos.

risks.risk: Headlamps may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing both headlamps turned on, with clear illumination and no flickering or dead spots.

risks.risk: Grill may be damaged or missing parts (e.g., mounting brackets, trim pieces)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all sides of the grill, including mounting points and any missing or broken components.

risks.risk: Headlamps may be mismatched or incompatible with the grill
risks.proof: Photo showing the back of the headlamps with part numbers or model identifiers, or a side-by-side comparison with a known compatible unit.

proof_requests: Video of both headlamps turned on to verify functionality.
Close-up photos of the back of the headlamps showing part numbers or model identifiers.
Photos of all sides of the grill, including mounting points and any missing parts.
Photo showing the back of the headlamps to confirm compatibility with the grill.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
